purpose.zh: 用髋部爆发力练臀部和大腿后侧
purpose.en: Build glute and hamstring power with a hip drive.

text.zh: 髋部向前猛推，让手臂把壶铃荡起
text.en: Snap your hips forward and let your arm float the bell up

text.zh: 背部平直，臀部向后推，壶铃在两腿之间
text.en: Keep your back flat and push your hips back with the bell between your thighs.

text.zh: 顶端站直夹臀，肋骨下沉，不后仰
text.en: Stand tall at the top, glutes tight, ribs down, no leaning back.

commonErrors.en: Lifting the bell with your arm.

cautions.zh: 从轻壶铃开始，周围留出空间；腰部疼痛时停止
cautions.en: Start with a light bell and clear space around you; stop if your lower back hurts.
